ai_summary: Arkade Developers Limited is issuing a routine regulatory intimation under SEBI Listing Regulations, notifying shareholders, especially those without registered email addresses, about its 40th Annual General Meeting (AGM) to be held virtually on September 22, 2026. The document provides crucial links for accessing the FY 2025-26 Annual Report and details for remote e-voting, ensuring shareholder participation in corporate governance. This is a standard procedural disclosure with no apparent material financial impacts or red flags.
